title: Worktree and branch patterns can lowercase the item id

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S31 preflight (2026-10-25): ork run ork S78 plans worktree .worktrees/S78 and branch S78, while this repo's convention (AGENTS.md, every hand-run relay) is lowercase, .worktrees/s78 on branch s78. The registry patterns support only {id} (docs/state.md:44-45), and the substitution is written twice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go:364-375` (plan worktree and branch) and `internal/engine/engine.go:122-139` (worktreePath, branch): one shared helper that fills the pattern.
- `internal/registry/registry.go:76-77` (WorktreePattern, BranchPattern) and `docs/state.md:44-45`: document an `{id_lower}` placeholder (proposed name).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestPatternIdLower: .worktrees/{id_lower} with item S78 gives .worktrees/s78; {id} is unchanged. TestPlanAndEngineAgreeOnPaths: the plan and the engine fill the same pattern the same way.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Add the placeholder in one helper used by both call sites, then set the ork project's registry patterns to .worktrees/{id_lower} and {id_lower} (the owner's registry, through ork's own config path, not by hand).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/daemon ./internal/engine ./internal/registry; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
